import asyncio

from seed import AsyncSeedApi

client = AsyncSeedApi()


async def main() -> None:
    await client.update_profile_identifier(
        profile_id="profile_123",
        id_type_path_param="email",
        id_type="phone",
        old_value="+13175556789",
        new_value="+13175556798",
    )


asyncio.run(main())
